'''Josh Bader No Risk Force Drain Deck''' is a [[Light]] constructed list published on Decipher Deck Designs.

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Josh Bader]]
* '''Published:''' March 1997 (Decipher Deck Designs)
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Hoth]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Hoth: Echo Command Center (War Room)|Hoth-L-hothechocommandcenterwarroom.gif}}
* '''Strategy:''' No Risk Force Drain Deck
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:PHoth No Risk Force Drain Deck Bader LS.txt |Download]]
